title: Jalapeño Popper Beef & Rice
description: High-protein, super flavorful, and easy one-pan meal prep.
steps: Brown your ground beef in a large pan. Season with salt, pepper, garlic, and Worcestershire.
Add in your diced onion and cook until softened.
Mix in the whipped cream cheese until melted and creamy.
Add jalapeños, cheddar, and bacon. Stir until everything is combined.
Add your cooked jasmine rice and fold it in well.
Mix your sauce separately and drizzle on top when serving.
Portion out for meal prep or devour it right away.
notes:
Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/14T5N1RZTAZ/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories Approximately 400 kcal per serving · Fat 20g · Saturated fat 8g · Unsaturated fat 12g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 80mg · Sodium 700mg · Carbs 45g · Fiber 4g · Sugar 8g · Protein 35g

healthy: 93/7 lean beef gives lots of protein with less fat.
Uses Greek yogurt and sugar-free chili sauce to lighten it.
not_healthy: Bacon, cheddar and cream cheese add saturated fat.
Bacon, pickled jalapenos and Worcestershire add sodium.
